data.name: Gerardo
data.long_meaning: From the Latin Gerardus, derived from the Germanic elements ger meaning 'spear' and hart meaning 'brave, strong' or 'hardy'. The name Gerardo was borne by several early Christian saints and was popular during the Middle Ages. In Christian tradition, Gerardo is associated with bravery, strength, and protection.
